**irr 50（2026-08-20・irr=70 の二重読み。v9.9.144 の5点検問）**　『Consistent with industry practice, most of our client contracts may be terminated by our clients without cause and do not commit our clients to provide us with a … specific volume of business.』（Item 1A Risk Factors「Client demand may be impacted by the selling cycle and terms of our client contracts」（…はページ区切り『12 Table of Contents』の省略））——会社自身が『大半の契約は無理由解約可・数量コミットなし』と断言＝検問4の自己否定。70の主張と正面衝突する　『Any failure to meet a client’s expectations or a change in a client’s strategic direction could result in the cancellation or Factors（同上））——台帳が『increase』と引いた当の文。原本は『decrease』で、内容は移行摩擦ではなく関係の脆さ　『Further, a client may choose to use its own internal resources rather than engage an outside firm to perform the types of services we provide, including by creating in-house global capability centers.』（Item 1A Risk Factors「We face competition globally from other providers and from our clients...」）——顧客の内製・垂直統合（検問4）　『The Company does not disclose the value of remaining performance obligations as a result of applying the practical expedient provided in ASC Topic 606』（Item 8 注記（Revenue — Remaining Performance Obligations））——契約済み残高というコミットの実数が存在しない。MSFT/MCOの70はここが数字で立っていた　《反証（同じ原本に同居する）》『Most of our digital operations solutions and services contracts are long term, typically ranging from three to five years, generally require a longer termination notice period and may include an early termination fee to be paid to us, which might not be sufficient to cover our costs or the loss of revenues and profit upon termination of the contract.』 ／ 『Together, these tools make AI deeply embedded in client workflows, delivering faster, more intelligent, end to end digital transformation.』　《射程》70候補（3〜5年契約＋解約金）が当たるのは digital operations のみで、売上 932,337／2,087,679 ＝ 44.7%。残り55.3%の data and AI-led 側は『project-based engagements generally does not exceed one year』。　《検問と反証の経緯》【70を支える文を探した経緯（実数つき）】原本436,627字を走査: switching cost 0 / switch 0 / lock-in 0 / installed base 0 / multi-year 0 / renewal rate 0 / retention rate 0 / retrain 0 / learning curve 0 / barrier 0 / new entrant 0 / insourc 0 / captive 0。RPOは practical expedient で非開示。材料の hits も全部読んだ（工程への組込14・複数年4・解約更新5・データ移行5）。
【唯一の70候補と、それが落ちた理由】『Most of our digital operations solutions and services contracts are long term, typically ranging from three to five years, generally require a longer termination notice period and may include an early termination fee to be paid to us』＝解約金は本物の機構。だが (a)射程が売上44.7%、(b)同じ文が『may include』『might not be sufficient to cover our costs』と自ら弱め、(c)決定的に、会社が umbrella で『most of our client contracts may be terminated by our clients without cause and do not commit our clients to provide us with a … specific volume of business』と否定する。これはMAの『Many of our customer relationships are not exclusive』と同型の自己否定。
【他の候補も落ちた】『make AI deeply embedded in client workflows』は摩擦を一言も述べない宣伝文（RMD型）。『higher cost of revenues ... during the initial 12 to 18 months in our long-term contracts due to upfront investments in infrastructure, resource hiring and training during migration』は当社が負う立ち上げ費用＝向きが逆（検問3(2)）。『selling cycle ... six to eighteen months』＋実装6〜12ヶ月も当社が外側にいるときの参入コスト（ONTO型）。migrat 8件は当社が顧客のレガシー移行を請け負うサービス紹介であって障壁ではない。
【反証】顧客の内製を2箇所で明記（GCC＝global capability centers）。
【evidence_gap】★台帳の旧根拠は原本と語が逆。台帳は『increase in the scope of services and solutions that we are able to provide to such client』を業務埋込みの証拠として引くが、原本を grep すると 'increase in the scope' は0件、'decrease in the scope' が1件で、実際の文は『Any failure to meet a client's expectations or a change in a client's strategic direction could result in the cancellation or non-renewal of a contract or a decrease in the scope...』＝関係の脆さを述べるリスク要因。一語の反転で意味が逆転していた（MSIの『reduce barriers to entry』を根拠にした型と同族）。旧根拠自身も『証拠は薄めのため保守』と自認していた。
